server_description: Local filesystem operations for reading, writing, inspecting, copying, moving, deleting, and discovering files and directories.
Document-oriented operations for extracting, searching, summarizing, and inspecting structured and unstructured documents.
Structured relational database operations for querying, inspecting, inserting, updating, deleting, and aggregating data.
Synthetic web retrieval and extraction operations for pages, links, metadata, search results, and structured information.
Academic and technical research operations for papers, metadata, citations, comparisons, and summaries.
Synthetic email operations for sending, searching, reading, replying, drafting, and archiving messages.
Calendar and scheduling operations for creating, searching, updating, deleting, and checking event availability.
Synthetic team messaging operations involving channels, messages, threads, workspace history, and search.
Source-control operations for repositories, branches, commits, diffs, status, and history.
Software issue and project-tracking operations for searching, reading, creating, updating, and commenting on development tasks.
Natural-language transformation and analysis operations including summarization, translation, sentiment, extraction, rewriting, and classification.
Deterministic mathematical and numerical operations for arithmetic, statistics, percentages, finance, and equations.
Operations for inspecting, filtering, sorting, grouping, transforming, and analyzing tabular datasets.
Structured JSON operations for parsing, querying, validation, transformation, and comparison.
Safe synthetic system-information operations for machine state, storage, memory, processes, and environment data.
Geographic operations for locations, coordinates, distances, time zones, and country information.
Synthetic image and media operations for metadata, dimensions, resizing, cropping, format conversion, and content description.
General deterministic utility operations involving dates, identifiers, hashing, encoding, and decoding.
